messages.subject: Paris, France. Stan talk tonight at ML meetup, Stan for Pharmacometrics workshop on Thursday
parts:
Hi all,

If you're in Paris, there are two free Stan-related talks / events. 

The first is happening tonight. It's an intro talk geared at a machine learning audience by Eric Novik (er...@stan.fit). Michael Betancourt and I will be on the panel afterwards.
http://www.meetup.com/Dataiku-User-Group-France/events/233943269/?eventId=233943269

On Thursday, there's a workshop geared towards pharmacometric modeling. 9 am - 5 pm. Lots of speakers. Should be a fun event.
https://www.eventbrite.com/e/stan-for-pharmacometrics-day-tickets-25399716235?aff=es2



Daniel
